headline: Brazil November Corn Exports Projected at Three-Year High
summary: Brazilian grain exporter group Anec estimated November corn exports will reach 8.06 million tonnes, the highest monthly shipment level since September 2023, reflecting abundant domestic surpluses.
why: Brazil is one of the world's top two corn exporters. Heavy export volumes impact global livestock feed prices and competitive dynamics for US and Ukrainian grain sellers.

impacts.name: Corn Futures
impacts.why: Large Brazilian export volumes increase international grain availability, capping prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
